topic_thesis: Failing to link your active mobile number on the VAHAN and SARATHI portals gives insurance companies an ironclad excuse to reject a ₹5,00,000 accident claim while hidden e-challans compound silently into court summons.
strategic_angle: Expose the double-trap: Insurance companies exploit registry-KYC mismatches between your Driving License/RC and policy documents to flag vehicle records as non-compliant and reject third-party/own-damage claims. Simultaneously, the RTO's automated e-challan system silently accumulates unpaid fines against your old inactive number, leading to blacklisted RCs without a single SMS alert reaching you.
key_statistic: ₹5,00,000 claim rejected to ₹0 & 5x compounding e-challan penalties
target_emotion: Urgent anxiety and immediate urge to audit Parivahan portal KYC
